primary_chain_dispositions.rationale: Repair the lost action-relevant history and finite-area contact distinctions, without presupposing whether their best inductive bias is physical, learned, or hybrid.
The performance choice and the applied action must be one relation containing physical, energy, actuator and deadline authority.

required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Represent the smallest safely observable history whose action-conditional outcome set preserves robust impedance feasibility and ranking, and adapt that set after an admitted calibration-out change rather than only detecting or rejecting it.

required_mechanism_changes.causal_position: Between observation history and impedance selection
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: Material, geometry, sliding condition or contact history changes future capacity or the preferred feasible impedance
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The controller needs distinctions that alter its decision, not a generally complete contact digital twin.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: A performance gain is proposed before contact, energy, actuator, infeasibility and deadline checks, so the intended and applied actions diverge or no timely action exists.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Map every update state to either a jointly feasible normal-tangential impedance or a declared feasible withdrawal action in one total relation.
required_mechanism_changes.change_direction: FROM proposal-then-correction TO constraint-internalized total applied action
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: Uncertainty, hard margins or computation availability becomes active
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The relation remains meaningful under optimization success, infeasibility, support loss and timeout.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Predict action-conditional force, path, slip/contact-loss, energy and actuator margins from safely observable history.
acceptance_conditions: Every retained state family changes robust feasible actions or their ranking on held-out decisions.

required_capabilities.required_capability: After support loss inside a declared envelope, update the outcome relation and recover useful decision ordering while never relaxing independently valid envelope margins.
acceptance_conditions: Logged in-envelope changes cause valid prediction and action-ranking recovery; outside-envelope cases withdraw.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Choose contact-frame normal and tangential stiffness/damping only from actions satisfying contact, wrench, energy, actuator and gain-rate limits.
acceptance_conditions: No downstream guard changes an action called feasible.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Publish a relation member at every deadline.
acceptance_conditions: Every compute and support outcome has an on-time logged feasible scan or withdrawal action.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Define history equivalence over the impedance decision class and discard prediction detail that does not change feasible actions or ranking.
acceptance_conditions: Nested ablation finds the smallest state within a predeclared decision-regret tolerance.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Separate supported calibration, in-envelope set adaptation and outside-envelope withdrawal; an adaptive posterior may shape cost or further restrict actions but cannot relax the envelope authority.
acceptance_conditions: No arbitrary-shift guarantee; support, containment, contraction and withdrawal are separately auditable.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Apply every hard margin, including accumulated interaction energy, to the same gain sequence optimized for task performance.
acceptance_conditions: Penalties are not called limits and post-hoc projection is excluded from the claim.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Register a rate- and actuator-feasible unloading action before optimization and atomically publish only verified relation members.
acceptance_conditions: Forced interruption affects cost, not action existence or declared feasibility.

premises: Only contact distinctions that change feasible actions or ranking are necessary.
Calibration-out adaptation must change the predictive relation, not merely flag it.
derivation_steps: Define action equivalence over the four-gain decision class.
Predict the smallest multistep outcome vector needed by cost and constraints.
Use calibrated authority on support, a containing adaptive envelope set after in-envelope support loss, and withdrawal outside it.

assumptions: A declared adaptation envelope contains the target shifts.
The outcome state is observable enough to update.

premises: A hard limit constrains the rendered action.

Union verified scan actions with a preverified unloading member and publish atomically by deadline.

search_space_closures.closure_rationale: Evidence closes the required relation but not the best representation bias; preserve all three rather than invent uniqueness.
The RMC fixes totality and hard-limit internalization; solver brand, exact horizon and set representation do not survive the removal test as scientific mechanisms.

principle_search_record.closure_rationale: R11 closes the common RMC-required relation and explicitly leaves only the representation inductive bias underconstrained. Exact recurrent architecture, estimator geometry, optimizer, information bonus and numerical horizon are implementation freedoms.

solution_space_constraint_assessment.constraint_basis: The accepted envelope is bounded rather than arbitrary, and current direct contact Evidence supports a compact hereditary finite-area physical family while not establishing a decision-relevant residual that survives its bounded online adaptation. A pure learned predictor adds calibration-data and extrapolation assumptions; a physical-plus-learned residual adds both model classes without an independently established residual MUST. Under the strongest-simple-rival rule, the bounded physical decision-outcome route is therefore the unique retained Method. Learned and hybrid representations remain falsifying comparators: physical-family noncontainment or persistent action-changing residual would return this choice to method_design.

candidate_principles.principle: A bounded hereditary finite-area normal-tangential contact-capacity set is updated from the scan history and consumed by one robust, energy-aware, deadline-total four-gain impedance relation.
candidate_principles.origin_chain_rationale: RT-R11-PHYSICAL derives the RMC1 history/capacity representation; FP-R11-TOTAL-RELATION and RT-R11-TOTAL-ACTION derive the RMC2 constraint-internalized energy, feasibility, withdrawal and deadline relation. The Candidate is their minimal serial closure, not a representation-only binding.
activation_conditions: The true contact remains inside the declared finite-area hereditary/pre-slip envelope but can leave the calibration population.
Relaxation, contact area or tangential pre-slip changes a current four-gain decision.
At least one wrench, contact, interaction-energy, actuator, gain-rate or deadline margin can become active.
candidate_principles.intervention: Represent contact by nonnegative generalized-Maxwell normal memory and a bounded elasto-plastic tangential bristle/finite-area limit-surface state; maintain a drift-propagated fixed-facet parameter polytope from force/torque and kinematic consistency; propagate candidate positive normal/tangential stiffness-damping sequences through that set; and atomically apply only a completely verified robust scan member or the preverified unloading member at the update deadline.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: NNBO's trial-fixed scalar point-contact law and proposal-then-realization chain become a history-bearing set-valued contact-capacity relation whose same member defines the optimized, energy-authorized, actuator-feasible and applied impedance action.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: Normal relaxation, area evolution and tangential pre-slip/moment capacity are preserved exactly where they alter robust gain feasibility or ranking. Drift/reset set membership changes the predictive relation after an admitted calibration-out contact without treating confidence as authority. Robust multistep selection and a registered withdrawal make physical, energy, actuator and compute outcomes part of the applied-action relation rather than downstream corrections.
failure_conditions: The best bounded physical family leaves a persistent action-changing residual under admitted contacts.
A calibrated memoryless finite-area law is action-equivalent.
The parameter set cannot contract before the changed decision is needed.
Four diagonal contact-frame gains are dominated by a richer action class under matched constraints.
Energy accounting or withdrawal feasibility is not containing in the admitted envelope.
Nonoptional update and publication exceed the reserved deadline.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A low-order nonnegative generalized-Maxwell normal model plus elasto-plastic pre-slip and finite-area wrench capacity contains the admitted material, geometry, sliding and history effects at the controller-consumed outcome level.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Return to method_design and admit a structured learned residual or learned outcome Candidate; the physical-only Principle is rejected.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Force/torque and kinematic scan history provides consistency strips that contract decision-relevant parameter directions before their action consequence expires.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Online adaptation reduces to conservative refusal and fails the accepted calibration-out performance problem.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Positive diagonal contact-frame gains (k_n,d_n,k_t,d_t) span the action differences required by force regulation, tangential tracking, slip and contact retention in the accepted scan task.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Expand the action class only after matched-budget action-equivalence falsifies the four-gain class.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: The discrete interaction-energy balance upper-bounds gain-change, moving-reference, delay and inner-loop mismatch work over one update interval.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The optimizer cannot claim energy-authorized applied gains.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A rate-, actuator- and energy-feasible tangential-stop/normal-unload action exists throughout the declared withdrawal envelope, and its verification/publication WCET fits the reserved deadline.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The total-action relation and RMC2 closure fail; viability or a narrower envelope must be reconsidered.

target_domain_operationalization: Contact state: use an offline selected smallest nonnegative Prony/Maxwell bank for normal fading memory, an area/curvature proxy from robot-side geometry sensing, and a LuGre-type bounded pre-slip bristle state whose load-dependent finite-area limit surface bounds tangential force and torsional moment. Retain a state coordinate only if removing it changes the robust four-gain feasible set or action order beyond the declared decision-regret tolerance.

Calibration-out adaptation: parameterize controller-consumed normal-force, tangential-force/moment and contact-retention margins affine or locally affine in effective physical parameters. Propagate a declared bounded-drift fixed-facet H-polytope, intersect it with every force/torque/kinematic consistency strip, and compute a conservative fixed-complexity outer polytope. On the first inconsistent drift update, reset once to the offline physical envelope intersected with the current strip; a second inconsistency, empty intersection or envelope violation selects withdrawal. The Chebyshev center affects cost only; every polytope member constrains action.

Action and horizon: optimize a_i=(log k_n,log d_n,log k_t,log d_t), with positivity intrinsic and rate limits explicit. Use the shortest receding horizon covering the measured 95-percent normal relaxation, pre-slip transition and energy-accumulation interval that changes the current action; H=1 is retained only if delayed-state action equivalence is demonstrated.

Robust objective and constraints: minimize worst-case normal force error, tangential path error, contact-loss/slip risk and gain variation. For every uncertainty vertex/tube step enforce six-axis wrench and finite-area capacity, contact retention, joint torque/velocity, actuator saturation, gain/rate and a discrete energy-budget state that reserves bounded reference, delay and inner-loop work. No downstream passivity filter may alter a gain called feasible.

Concrete online realization: use warm-started direct multiple shooting with RTI-SQP and fixed-complexity robust vertices because the selected physical state is smooth, low dimensional and nonlinear; solver identity is not a Contribution. A shifted warm start is reverified, and only fully completed robust checks are published.

Total action: before optional optimization, verify and register a rate-limited action that stops tangential reference motion, transitions to dissipative gains and unloads along the last trusted normal. At the deadline atomically apply the lowest-cost fully verified scan action, otherwise the registered withdrawal. Timeout and infeasibility change performance, not action existence.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: At representation level, NNBO and the tissue-model comparator cover calibrated scalar HC/Kelvin-type laws but not a decision-pruned hereditary finite-area normal-tangential capacity set; finite-area viscoelastic theory supplies that state but no online impedance decision. At adaptation level, deformable-contact MPC pre-estimates properties, while learned/GP MPVIC work uses offline or point/probabilistic prediction rather than an in-contact containing physical set. At decision level, prior model-to-MPC routes do not make the same four-gain member jointly responsible for finite-area slip/moment, accumulated energy, actuator limits and deadline-total scan-or-withdraw realization.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: Replace point/preidentified contact prediction by an online containing hereditary contact-capacity set, then make that set and accumulated energy internal constraints of the same deadline-total normal-tangential impedance action.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Establish whether the smallest interpretable hereditary contact-capacity state is sufficient to recover useful calibration-out four-gain decisions, and whether constraint-total use of that state prevents intended/applied impedance divergence.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: A set-valued hereditary finite-area contact-capacity model defined by downstream four-gain decisions and embedded in one energy- and deadline-total applied-action relation; not a generic richer contact model and not a neural replacement of HC.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Relative to NNBO it changes scalar trial-fixed HC into online hereditary finite-area normal-tangential capacity and changes unconstrained one-axis optimal impedance into robust four-gain total action. Relative to deformable-contact MPC it selects impedance and adapts properties in contact. Relative to learned and adaptive MPVIC it makes bounded history/capacity uncertainty, not a point or mean model, authorize the applied scan action.

predictions.observable: Paired-history robust feasible-set disagreement and selected-action regret at matched instantaneous indentation, velocity and wrench
predictions.pattern_a: Hereditary/area/pre-slip state predicts different active capacity margins and the observed better action.
predictions.pattern_b: The calibrated memoryless finite-area model is action-equivalent.
predictions.activation_condition: Loading or sliding histories differ while current point variables match.
predictions.killer_criterion: Action equivalence within the declared regret tolerance kills the history state and collapses the Method to the simpler model.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Logged counterfactual replay isolates representation before controller experiments.

predictions.observable: Containing-set validity, contraction time and recovery of force/path/slip action ordering after an admitted shift
predictions.pattern_a: Drift/reset polytope remains containing and changes the robust optimum before the changed action is needed.
predictions.pattern_b: The set stays vacuous or a fixed envelope/fixed impedance is decision-equivalent.
predictions.activation_condition: A material, geometry, friction or history change is outside calibration support but inside the physical envelope.
predictions.killer_criterion: Unsupported detection without a valid useful action change kills calibration-out adaptation.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: The same replay compares set membership, set-MHE and fixed-envelope robust alternatives under identical observations; estimator geometry is selected by containment and WCET, not brand.

predictions.observable: Joint force/path/slip regret and active constraints under four gains versus full SPD contact-frame impedance and reference co-optimization
predictions.pattern_a: Four gains are action-equivalent within tolerance with lower uncertainty and compute burden.
predictions.pattern_b: Cross-axis/off-diagonal or reference decisions remove persistent joint regret unavailable to four gains.
predictions.activation_condition: Curved patches and changing scan direction activate normal-tangential coupling.
predictions.killer_criterion: A matched-budget richer action produces a non-equivalent feasible improvement that cannot be represented by four gains.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Offline counterfactual optimization separates action-class sufficiency from controller tuning.

predictions.observable: Current-action disagreement and later margin violation for one-step versus shortest memory-covering horizon
predictions.pattern_a: Delayed relaxation, pre-slip, gain reachability or energy makes the multistep current action uniquely feasible or lower regret.
predictions.pattern_b: One-step constrained selection is action-equivalent after matched terminal margins.
predictions.activation_condition: A delayed contact or resource state persists beyond one update.
predictions.killer_criterion: One-step action equivalence across the admitted envelope removes the horizon mechanism.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Model replay isolates horizon without changing constraints, energy or action class.

predictions.observable: Selected/applied gain identity and measured energy reserve under gain/reference variation
predictions.pattern_a: The optimizer-consumed state selects a gain that is applied unchanged and respects the reserve.
predictions.pattern_b: A post-hoc passivity mechanism is action-equivalent or the integrated balance misses injected work.
predictions.activation_condition: Energy is active while uncertainty and deadline remain inactive.
predictions.killer_criterion: Unmodeled energy or any downstream gain change kills integrated energy authority.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Energy-only replay and trace audit avoid conflating uncertainty or timeout.

predictions.observable: On-time membership of the applied action during forced solver interruption or infeasibility
predictions.pattern_a: Every update applies either a completely verified scan member or the registered withdrawal.
predictions.pattern_b: Holding a previous action or a faster solver is equally total and feasible, or withdrawal misses the deadline/envelope.
predictions.activation_condition: Computation is interrupted while energy and support remain fixed.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any missing deadline member, infeasible held action or unverified withdrawal kills totality.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Deterministic interruption traces isolate compute totality from physical margins.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Selected as the evidence-supported strongest simple route. Learned-only and hybrid are not retained because current Evidence establishes neither physical-family noncontainment nor a persistent decision-relevant residual; adding either would introduce unneeded data, extrapolation and uncertainty-composition assumptions.
